title: Yahoo Finance Historical Prices - OHLCV, Dividends & Splits
description: Minimal input: {"tickers": ["AAPL"], "maxRowsPerTicker": 3}. Each parsed source response costs $0.003 plus $0.0002 per delivered row. Empty/unchanged successful checks are billed. maxTotalChargeUsd belongs in Apify run options.

tickers.title: Ticker symbols
tickers.description: Yahoo ticker symbols, for example ["AAPL","MSFT","BTC-USD","VOD.L"]. Up to 20; no URLs. Each successful history fetch costs $0.003 plus $0.0002 per delivered daily bar. Data retains source currency units, including GBp for pence.

maxRowsPerTicker.title: Maximum rows per ticker
maxRowsPerTicker.description: Output ceiling per original source, for example 50. Applied after filters, exclusions and monitoring. Each delivered row costs $0.0002; source checks are separate. Fewer rows may exist. Newest daily bars are delivered first.

range.title: History range
range.description: Relative daily history, for example "1mo" or "1y". Default 1mo. Ignored when both dates are provided. No intraday data. One successful history check per ticker costs $0.003; delivered bars cost $0.0002 each.

startDate.title: Start date, inclusive
startDate.description: Exchange-calendar date in YYYY-MM-DD format, for example "2020-08-01". Set endDate too; both dates override range. Empty uses range. Maximum ten-year window. This selects daily bars, not intraday observations.

endDate.title: End date, exclusive
endDate.description: Exchange-calendar date, for example "2020-10-01" includes bars before October 1. Set startDate too. Empty uses range. Maximum tomorrow. Source weekends and holidays do not create rows.

onlyNewOrChanged.title: Only new or changed daily bars
onlyNewOrChanged.description: false by default. true remembers delivered ticker/date bars under monitorKey and returns new or revised values. Adjusted-close noise within one part per million is ignored; other fields compare exactly. First run returns the baseline. A successful history check costs $0.003 even with no new rows.

monitorKey.title: Monitor name
monitorKey.description: Name such as "daily-research"; default "default". Reuse it for repeat runs. Targets, date window, locale and filters automatically form a separate baseline when changed. Keeps the latest 50,000 IDs per scope. Do not overlap runs with the same name and scope.

excludeIds.title: Previously collected IDs
excludeIds.description: Optional output id values, for example ["previous-output-id"]. Up to 10,000. Empty [] excludes nothing. Useful for caller-managed deduplication. Excluded rows are not charged; parsed source checks are.

maxRequests.title: Maximum HTTP requests
maxRequests.description: Hard run-wide source request cap, for example 100; range 1–200. This is not a dollar limit. Set maxTotalChargeUsd as an Apify run option for a monetary cap.
